title: Microsoft Purview DLP: delegate Copilot and Cowork policies to administrative units
summary: The briefing's policy scoping, permissions, prerequisites and roadmap targets are supported by Microsoft's sources. The role-group assignment route omits a page heading, a minor correction that does not prevent administrators from finding the control.

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-10-13T23:01:05.
Microsoft Purview DLP is extending administrative unit support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat and Cowork.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Policy management can be delegated to administrators within assigned units without tenant-wide policy-management permissions.
claims.quote: This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes support for regional, departmental and regulatory boundaries.
claims.quote: supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply.
claims.quote: Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Using administrative-unit-scoped management is optional.
claims.quote: configuration is optional for organizations choosing to use Administrative Unit (AU)-scoped management.

claims.claim: The administrative-unit control is admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply, and configuration is optional for organizations choosing to use Administrative Unit (AU)-scoped management.

claims.claim: An administrative unit is a subset of the Microsoft Entra directory, such as a region or department.
claims.quote: By using administrative units in Microsoft Entra ID, you can subdivide your organization into smaller units and restrict administrative permissions to specific parts of your Microsoft Entra organization.

claims.claim: A DLP policy for the Copilot, Copilot Chat and Cowork location can be scoped to one or more administrative units.
claims.quote: An unrestricted administrator can scope policies to administrative units or keep Full directory to apply a policy across the organization.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Purview route is Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Admin units.
claims.quote: go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. ... Select the Custom template, then Custom policy ... On the Admin units page, select the administrative units for the policy.

claims.claim: After choosing administrative units, administrators select the Copilot location and choose users and groups to include or exclude within those units.
claims.quote: Select the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location and choose the users and groups to include or exclude within the selected administrative units.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance controls table
claims.claim: A restricted administrator can select only their assigned administrative units.
claims.quote: An administrative unit restricted administrator can select only their assigned units and manage policies within that scope.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: Restricted administrators manage policies within their assigned unit scope.
claims.quote: An administrative unit restricted administrator can select only their assigned units and manage policies within that scope.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Unrestricted administrators can keep the default Full directory scope.
claims.quote: Unrestricted administrators don't have to select administrative units as part of the policy configuration. They can keep the default of the entire directory or select one or more administrative units.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Copilot DLP administrative-unit scope follows the user who submits the prompt, not the file or email owner.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft's Finance example applies the policy to Finance users even when they access content owned outside Finance.
claims.quote: a policy scoped to the Finance administrative unit applies to Finance users' Copilot and Cowork interactions, even when they access content owned by someone outside Finance.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance controls

claims.quote: DLP alerts and Activity explorer visibility follow the administrator's assigned administrative units and permissions.

claims.claim: Activity explorer visibility follows the administrator's assigned units and permissions.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and Activity explorer visibility follow the administrator's assigned administrative units and permissions.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope
claims.claim: The administrative-unit option might not yet be available in a tenant.
claims.quote: The option might not yet be available in your tenant.

claims.claim: Before creating a scoped policy, configure Entra administrative units and assign them to appropriate Purview role-group members.
claims.quote: Before you create a scoped policy, configure administrative units in Microsoft Entra ID and assign them to the appropriate Microsoft Purview role group members.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrative-unit assignment does not replace the DLP permissions required to create and manage policies.
claims.quote: Administrative unit admins need to be assigned to one of the same roles or role groups as administrators of unrestricted DLP policies in order to create and manage DLP policies for their administrative unit.

claims.claim: Assigning administrative units to role-group members requires the Role management role.
claims.quote: To assign a role group member to an administrative unit, administrators must be assigned the Role management role.

claims.claim: The unit-assignment route is Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > role group > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users > Assign admin units.
claims.quote: On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select a Microsoft Purview role group you want to add users to. Select Edit on the control bar. ... On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.
claims.fix: In controls[1].ui and the rendered table, include the omitted heading: 'Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > role group > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users > Assign admin units'. The cited permissions page documents this heading.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy-name> -PolicyRBACScopes <administrative-unit-GUIDs> assigns administrative units to a new DLP policy.
claims.quote: The PolicyRBACScopes parameter specifies the administrative units to assign to the policy. A valid value is the Microsoft Entra ObjectID (GUID value) of the administrative unit.

claims.claim: PolicyRBACScopes values are Entra object GUIDs, with multiple values separated by commas.
claims.quote: A valid value is the Microsoft Entra ObjectID (GUID value) of the administrative unit. You can specify multiple values separated by commas.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy is documented for Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: An automation operation assigning administrative units to a Purview role-group member is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview assign administrative units role group member PowerShell API; RoleGroup AdministrativeUnits Purview; Purview role group administrative units PowerShell scope. Read purview-permissions, purview-admin-units and Add-RoleGroupMember; no assignment operation found.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: For overlapping capabilities, an Entra role overrides a scoped Purview assignment and grants unscoped effective access.
claims.quote: Entra roles always take precedence, and scoping applied through Administrative Units doesn't restrict the user's effective permissions for overlapping capabilities.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: After unit assignment, restricted role-group members cannot see or edit existing policies.
claims.quote: After you assign administrative units to members of the role groups, these restricted administrators can't see and edit existing policies.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Newly restricted administrators cannot see historical alerts.
claims.quote: Restricted administrators also can't see historical data by using features that support administrative units, such as activity explorer and alerts.

claims.claim: Newly restricted administrators cannot see historical Activity explorer data.
claims.quote: Restricted administrators also can't see historical data by using features that support administrative units, such as activity explorer and alerts.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Unrestricted administrators retain organisation-wide access to policies, alerts and events.
claims.quote: Unrestricted administrators can manage all policies and see all the alerts and events that flow from policy matches into the Alerts dashboard and DLP Activity Explorer.

claims.claim: Going forward, restricted administrators see related alerts and Activity explorer data only for assigned units.
claims.quote: Going forward, restricted administrators can see this related data for their assigned administrative units only.
